raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  name: cassandra-driver
  version: "3.30.1"

package:
  name: ${{ name|lower }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/${{ name[0] }}/${{ name }}/${{ name | replace('-', '_') }}-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 0c6a3e1428f7c6a9aa6c944b9c47a37cd2cdbeb5b5a82d42c33afdd56f14e398
  patches:
    - if: win
      then: disable-libev-windows.patch

build:
  number: 2
  script: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . --no-deps --no-build-isolation -vv

requirements:
  build:
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then: python
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then: cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then: cython >=3.0
    - ${{ compiler('c') }}
    - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
  host:
    - python
    - pip
    - setuptools
    - cython >=3.0
    - if: not win
      then: libev
    - tomli
  run:
    - python
    - deprecated >=1.3.1
    - geomet >=1.1
    - numpy
    - if: not win
      then: libev

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - cassandra
        - cassandra.cqlengine
        - cassandra.io
        - if: not win and python_impl == 'cpython'
          then: cassandra.numpy_parser
      pip_check: true

about:
  license: Apache-2.0
  license_file: LICENSE
  summary: Python driver for Cassandra
  description: |
    A modern, feature-rich and highly-tunable Python client library for Apache Cassandra (2.1+)
    using exclusively Cassandra’s binary protocol and Cassandra Query Language v3.
  homepage: http://github.com/datastax/python-driver
  repository: http://github.com/datastax/python-driver
  documentation: http://datastax.github.io/python-driver/api/index.html

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - petercable
    - anirrudh
    - scopatz
    - xylar
